Binaries can be used with speculos https://github.com/LedgerHQ/speculos.
Command: `speculos nanosplus/iota` where `iota` is the binary.

*.hex files can be loaded on a real device with https://github.com/LedgerHQ/ledgerctl.

First install ledgerctl https://github.com/LedgerHQ/ledgerctl?tab=readme-ov-file#install.

Then download the *.tar.gz file for your device, unpack it and install it with the following commands (replace `nanosplus` with `nanox` if needed):
`tar -xvzf nanosplus.tar.gz`
`ledgerctl install -f app_nanosplus.json`
